stem: Two irrigation sources have similar pH but very different alkalinity. What is the strongest conclusion?
choices: They will buffer the root zone identically
Their long-term influence on media/root-zone pH can differ because alkalinity measures acid-neutralizing capacity, not just current pH
Alkalinity and pH are the same measurement
rationale: pH and alkalinity answer different questions; alkalinity reflects bicarbonate/carbonate buffering delivered repeatedly with irrigation.
